runs.content: ConocoPhillips (COP) picked up at the previous close ($115.04) — Energy was today's leading sector as Brent/WTI spiked on fresh Iran Strait-of-Hormuz shipping restrictions, reinforced by a same-day Q2 earnings beat (EPS $3.24 vs. $2.88 est.) and $3.0B returned to shareholders. No exits today despite a softer broad tape (Dow −0.9%, S&P −0.2%): no position breached the −15% stop, hit a new T1/T2, or tripped the Burry signal-exit rule; FICO rallied to −11.06% (still WATCH, well off stop) while RIVN (−9.43%) and JBHT (−8.63%) drifted further into WATCH, none with a Burry conflict. A stale NVO price from yesterday was corrected to its verified $44.53 close. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,248 (+2.66% on $47,000).

Amgen (AMGN) picked up at the previous close ($390.02) — Q2 2026 beat-and-raise (EPS $6.29 vs. $5.62 est., revenue $10.1B vs. $9.4B est.) drove a record-high close on outsized volume, with no Burry conflict. RDW hit T1 today (+25.50% @ $10.63) — 1/3 sold, ~$418 proceeds, remaining 2/3 runs toward T2. No other exits: FICO improved marginally to −14.70% (WATCH, $3.75 above stop) and RIVN improved to −8.27% (off the −10% signal threshold), neither with a Burry conflict. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,148 (+2.50% on $46,000).
